description: Get a random chess puzzle. Filter by variant, difficulty or theme. Not every variant puzzle carries themes; use chess_list_puzzle_types to see what the pool holds.

difficulty.description: Puzzle difficulty by rating: easy under 1200, medium 1200-1799, hard 1800 and above

theme.description: Puzzle theme (fork, pin, skewer, mateIn2, etc). Not every variant puzzle carries themes.

variant.description: Chess variant slug, camelCase or kebab-case (e.g. almost-chess, capablanca, king-of-the-hill, standard). Returns only puzzles for this variant.

name: chess_generate_puzzle
